# Smail et al., 2023 - Neurobiology of Loss: BLA, ECM & Microglia

Multiomics (RNAseq, Proteomics, Kinomics)

Note did pooling so no p-values, also only go one usable replicate for their one-shot proteomics, so data quality is not the best.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggrepel) #  for geom_text_repel() for volcano plot annotations
library(gt) # for heat maps to got with DESeq2 
library(colorspace)
```

```{r}
Proteomics_DE_raw <- read_excel("input/Smail_2023_SuppData3_Proteomics_Kinomics.xlsx",
                                sheet = "Proteomics DE") %>%
  mutate(ID = str_to_title(Protein), .after = Protein)

# Proteomics_DE_raw  <- rename(Proteomics_DE_raw, ID = Protein) # rename Protein to ID - to merge with RNA data
```

```{r}
RNAseq_exp2_raw <- read_excel("input/Smail_2023_SuppData2_Transcriptomics_Exp2&3.xlsx",
                             sheet = 'Experiment 2 DE', skip = 1)

RNAseq_exp3_raw <- read_excel("input/Smail_2023_SuppData2_Transcriptomics_Exp2&3.xlsx",
                             sheet = 'Experiment 3 DE', skip = 1)
```

```{r}
RNA_Prot_raw_df <- bind_rows(list('2_mRNA' = RNAseq_exp2_raw, '3_mRNA' = RNAseq_exp3_raw,
                                  '3_Protein' = Proteomics_DE_raw |> select(!Peptide)),
                             .id = 'Exp') %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Exp, delim = "_", names = c('ExpNo', 'Method'))
```

```{r}
head(Proteomics_DE_raw)
dim(Proteomics_DE_raw) # 400 x 5
length(unique(Proteomics_DE_raw$Protein)) # 205 unique 
```

```{r}
Proteomics_DE_2 <- Proteomics_DE_raw %>%
  group_by(Protein) %>% 
  mutate(pepcount = n()) %>% # no. of peptides (for that protein)
  mutate(across(c("EEvSH", "ERvSH", "ERvEE"),
                list(
                  mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm =TRUE),
                  med = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                  se = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)/ sqrt(sum(!is.na(.x)))
                ),.names = "{.col}.{.fn}")) %>%
  select(!Peptide:ERvEE) %>%
  unique()

```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
proteomics_tile <- Proteomics_DE %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = EEvSH:ERvEE,
               names_to = 'comp',
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(comp = fct_relevel(comp, c('EEvSH', 'ERvSH','ERvEE'))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = comp, y = reorder(Gene, value), fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey10") +
  colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging("Blue-Red 2") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(subtitle = "Smail 2023 - EE vs SH vs ER - Rats BLA - Proteomics DE (means) - supp data file 3") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
        legend.position = "none"
        )

proteomics_tile
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

RNA

```{r}
head(RNA_Prot_raw_df)

# mean for multiobs
RNA_Prot_df <- RNA_Prot_raw_df %>% #38568
  #filter(!str_detect(ID, fixed("."))) 
  group_by(ExpNo, Method, ID) %>%
  summarise(across(c("EEvSH", "ERvSH", "ERvEE"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm =TRUE))) %>% # 37543
  ungroup()


RNA_Prot_df_3obs <- RNA_Prot_df %>%
  count(ID) %>%
  filter(n >= 3) %>% # 66
  pull(ID)
```

<https://stackoverflow.com/questions/62011413/ggplot2-bar-chart-order-by-values-of-one-group>

```{r}
RNA_Prot_long <- RNA_Prot_df %>%
  filter(ID %in%  RNA_Prot_df_3obs) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = EEvSH:ERvEE,
               names_to = 'comp',
               values_to = "meanFC") %>%
  mutate(comp = fct_relevel(comp, c('EEvSH', 'ERvSH','ERvEE'))) %>%
  mutate(Direction = if_else(meanFC > 0, 'Up', 'Down'))


EEvsSH_3obs_order <- RNA_Prot_long %>%
  filter(comp == "EEvSH" & Method == "Protein") %>%
  arrange(desc(meanFC)) %>%
  mutate(ID = factor(ID))
```

### 3 x 3 tile

```{r}
tile_x_3 <- RNA_Prot_long  %>%
  mutate(ID = factor(ID, levels = EEvsSH_3obs_order$ID, ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  # mutate(CompMethodExp = paste0(comp, " - ", Method, ' - Exp ', ExpNo)) %>%
    mutate(MethodExp = paste0(Method, ' - Exp ', ExpNo)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = ID, y = meanFC, color = Direction, alpha = abs(meanFC))) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'grey20', linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ID,
                   yend = meanFC, y = 0)) +
  geom_point(shape = 19, size = 3.5) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(.5, 0.95), guide = 'none') + # rev alpha so darker = more significant
  # geom_text(aes(label = gene_name), color = "grey10", size = 2.5,
  #           position = position_stack()) +

  # scale_fill_manual(breaks = c("Up", "Down"),
  #                    values = c("#dc322f", "#268bd2"),
  #                    guide = 'none') +
  # colorspace::scale_color_continuous_diverging("Blue-Red 2") +
  scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Up", "Down"),
                     values = c("#dc322f", "#268bd2"),
                     guide = 'none') +
  
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(comp~MethodExp, scales = "free") +
  
    theme_bw() +
  theme(
    #axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, # 90, hj1 t/R, vj.5 cent
                               size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, color = "grey10",
                               size = 7, face = 'italic'), # rota 90 & hjust=1 (top/right)
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
        ) 

# 
tile_x_3
```

### Export ranked gene lists for StringDB

```{r}
# gene list for 9 comparisons/labels 
RNA_Prot_long_ranked_gL <- RNA_Prot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = EEvSH:ERvEE,
               names_to = 'comp',
               values_to = "meanFC") %>%
  mutate(Label = paste0('Ex', ExpNo, '_', Method, '_', comp)) %>% # exp com label
  select(Label, ID, meanFC) %>%
  group_by(Label) %>% # group (9 labels)
  arrange(Label, -meanFC)  # ranks by pos-to-neg FC 


#split2list  
RNA_Prot_long_ranked_gL_split <- split(RNA_Prot_long_ranked_gL, # split to 9 list
                                       RNA_Prot_long_ranked_gL$Label)
```
